from src.nodes.base import BaseNode
from src.runtime.assets.metadata.asset_provenance import get_asset_provenance
import json

class Hou_Mcp_Asset_Provenance(BaseNode):
    name = "hou_mcp_asset_provenance"

    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        # [AUTO-GENERATED-PORTS-START]
        self.add_input("asset_id",      "string", widget_type="text")
        self.add_input("provider",      "string", widget_type="text", default="sketchfab_live")
        self.add_input("action",        "string", widget_type="text", default="report")
        self.add_input("scene_type",    "string", widget_type="text")
        self.add_input("workflow_name", "string", widget_type="text")
        self.add_output("provenance_report_json", "string")
        self.add_output("history_json",           "string")
        self.add_output("record_count",           "int")
        self.add_output("statistics_json",        "string")
        # [AUTO-GENERATED-PORTS-END]

    async def execute(self, inputs):
        asset_id      = inputs.get("asset_id") or ""
        provider      = inputs.get("provider") or "sketchfab_live"
        action        = (inputs.get("action") or "report").strip().lower()
        scene_type    = inputs.get("scene_type") or None
        workflow_name = inputs.get("workflow_name") or None
        prov          = get_asset_provenance()

        provenance_report_json = "{}"
        history_json           = "[]"
        record_count           = 0
        statistics_json        = "{}"

        try:
            if action == "report" and asset_id:
                report = prov.build_provenance_report(asset_id, provider)
                provenance_report_json = json.dumps(report, default=str)
                record_count = len(report.get("records", []))

            elif action == "history" and asset_id:
                history = prov.get_asset_history(asset_id, provider)
                history_json = json.dumps(history, default=str)
                record_count = len(history)

            elif action == "record_usage" and asset_id:
                prov.record_usage(asset_id, provider, scene_type, workflow_name)
                self.log_info(f"Recorded usage: {asset_id} in {scene_type or 'unknown'}")

            statistics_json = json.dumps(prov.get_statistics(), default=str)

        except Exception as exc:
            self.log_error(f"AssetProvenance error: {exc}")

        return {
            "provenance_report_json": provenance_report_json,
            "history_json":           history_json,
            "record_count":           record_count,
            "statistics_json":        statistics_json,
            "exec_out": True,
        }

def register_node():
    return Hou_Mcp_Asset_Provenance
